dynamic_engines.name: postgres-primary-cluster
dynamic_engines.creation_statement: CREATE USER {{username}} WITH PASSWORD '{{password}}' VALID UNTIL '{{expiration}}'; GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO {{username}};
dynamic_engines.revocation_statement: REVOKE ALL PRIVILEGES ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public FROM {{username}}; DROP USER IF EXISTS {{username}};
